import GRWTSK.NumberTheory.Zeta.Riemann.CriticalStripSeventeenBandEnclosure

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 8192

/-!
# Exact negative-real projection on the CLOSED sixteen-to-seventeen band
The complete tensor is checked against the rational polynomial itself. The
certificate supplies no claim about points outside this band or actual zeros
without the independent source-enclosure theorem.
SOURCE SCRIPTS / NOT_ELABORATED / NOT_KERNEL_AUDITED.
-/
namespace GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.CriticalStripHeightDescent.SeventeenBandJet.Certificate
open Complex Finset Set
noncomputable section

def basis (i : Fin 12) (u : ℝ) : ℝ := u ^ i.val * (1-u) ^ (11-i.val)
def value (u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 12, ∑ j : Fin 12, (coefficients i j : ℝ) * basis i u * basis j v

lemma value_nonneg {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1)
    (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) : 0 ≤ value u v := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  unfold basis
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity)
    (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hu _) (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hu1) _)))
    (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hv _) (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv1) _))

/-- All 144 integers are tied to the actual model by an exact identity. -/
theorem tensor_identity (u v : ℝ) : value u v =
    70368744177664 * (-(polynomial (⟨(1+u)/2,16+v⟩ : ℂ)).re - 9) := by
  norm_num [value,coefficients,basis,polynomial,coefficient,center,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ,pow_succ,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im]
  ring

theorem polynomial_projection {s : ℂ} (hx : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ s.re) (hx1 : s.re ≤ 1)
    (ht : (16 : ℝ) ≤ s.im) (ht1 : s.im ≤ 17) : (9 : ℝ) ≤ -(polynomial s).re := by
  have h := value_nonneg (u := 2*s.re-1) (v := s.im-16)
    (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [tensor_identity] at h
  have he : (⟨(1+(2*s.re-1))/2,16+(s.im-16)⟩ : ℂ) = s := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [Complex.mk_re,Complex.mk_im] <;> ring
  rw [he] at h
  linarith

/-- The same polynomial guard fails below the admitted band; this is not a zeta zero. -/
theorem projection_failure_below_band :
    -(polynomial (⟨1/2,14⟩ : ℂ)).re < (9 : ℝ) := by
  norm_num [polynomial,coefficient,center,Fin.sum_univ_succ,pow_succ,
    Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im]

end
end GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.CriticalStripHeightDescent.SeventeenBandJet.Certificate
